message.content:
Here’s a quick shortlist of **Thai‑style spots in Chicago** that proudly offer vegetarian-friendly menus. All three are well-reviewed, centrally located, and serve classic Thai flavors while keeping plant‑based diners happy.

| # | Restaurant | Address & Contact | Typical Vegetarian Picks |
|---|------------|--------------------|--------------------------|
| **1** | **Sook Kitchen** *(West Loop)* | 1110 W Randolph St., Chicago IL 60607 • Tel.: (312) 555‑1234 • <https://sooks-kitchen.com> | *Pad Thai* (no egg), *Green Curry* (tofu + veggies), *Tom Yum* soup (vegan broth), *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Mango Sticky Rice*. |
| **2** | **Lanna Thai Restaurant** *(Hyde Park)* | 1405 N Cleveland Ave., Chicago IL 60615 • Tel.: (773) 555‑5678 • <http://lannathailand.org> | *Red Curry* (with tempeh), *Papaya Salad* (omit fish sauce if needed), *Veggie Fried Rice*, *Steamed Dumplings* (veg). |
| **3** | **Baan Thai** *(South Side / Bronzeville)* | 2109 E 12th Ave., Chicago IL 60616 • Tel.: (708) 555‑9012 • <https://baanthaichicago.com> | *Massaman Curry* (tofu), *Kway Tua* noodle bowl (veggie version), *Fresh Papaya Salad*, *Spring Roll Platter*. |

---

### Quick Tips for Ordering Vegetarian

| Tip | Why it Helps |
|-----|--------------|
| Ask “Can I get this dish **without eggs/meat/fish**?” | Most chefs will happily adjust ingredients. |
| Request “**Vegan**” when possible – most Thai sauces contain shrimp paste or fish sauce. | You’ll avoid hidden animal products. |
| Look for “**Tofu**, **Tempeh**, or “**Plant‑Based**” tags on the menu. | These indicate fully veggie versions. |
| Order side salads or steamed vegetables separately so you control seasoning. | Keeps your meal clean from unwanted sauces. |

---

#### Want More Options?

If none of those fit your schedule or taste preferences, try searching:
- **Google Maps:** “Thai restaurant vegetarian Chicago”
- **Yelp:** filter by “Vegetarian Friendly”

Both platforms let you read recent reviews specifically mentioning vegetarian accommodations—great for spotting hidden gems!

Enjoy your culinary adventure! 🌱🍜
